4 problems to fix
  • Sites Up and up differ only in capital letters; rename one (Excel treats them as the same).
  • Up, A2: construction cost is negative.
  • Site Empty has no alternatives.
  • Site Empty has no alternatives.
  • The discount rate is 10 percent; the federal water resources rate is usually between 2 and 7 percent.
  • Target years run from 1 to 40; outputs are averaged over that span, but the period of analysis is 50 years.
  • No Action at Up has costs; CE/ICA uses each alternative's cost above No Action.
  • Up, A1: construction has no duration, so no interest during construction is charged.
  • Site up has only No Action; add alternatives to analyze it.
  • A plan formation rule names site Ghost, which is not in the study.
